review: Orthographic diagrams on PDF pages 4/6/7/12/16 checked visually. L1 and L2 generated wall/detail polygons were overlaid directly on the official source coordinates; all visible room partitions and stair treads align, and 72 independent wall/detail/door-gap checkpoints pass. Columns are solid black circles in architectural runs, not service-symbol circles. Wall strokes are >1 source unit, stair treads and handrails remain flat. Service leaders and PDF duplicate clipped drawing streams excluded. Page16's Piombi and attic/Great Council ceiling are drawn independently, not inferred from lower floors. All printed place numbers 1-38 retained, including duplicated cross-level stair/prison-entry labels; letter l has five distinct source anchors. Browser 3D rendering remains an integration-stage check.
